# NOTES ON TWO BOOKS (keep separate)

## BOOK 1: "Whatsoever a Man Soweth" by William Le Queux (Gutenberg 41092)

### Core cast
- **Wilfrid Hughes** – narrator; comfortably-off antiquary, bachelor, Bolton Street chambers; family seat Netherdene (let to cotton-spinner from Oldham); ~£1,000/yr. Old flame of Tibbie; Eton/Oxford with Eric.
- **Honourable Eva Sybil "Tibbie" Burnet** – 23, third daughter of late Viscount Scarcliff; gold-brown hair, clear blue eyes; drives 60 h.p. Mercedes; maid **Mason**; mother **Lady Scarcliff** (Grosvenor Street/Place; "the mater"); brother **Jack**, 10th Viscount Scarcliff (25, Stock Exchange, Magdalen friend of Winsloe; nickname "The Scrambler"); sisters **Cynthia** (Lady Wydcombe, Curzon Street; husband Lord Wydcombe, Highlands grouse-moor) and **Violet** (Countess of Alderholt).
- **Ellice Winsloe** – 38, tall, well-dressed, Cornish tin-mine heir; proposed to Tibbie; Tibbie's real enemy/blackmailer-associate; King Street, St James's chambers; club Boodle's, Burlington; later fled (traced to Buenos Ayres).
- **Eric Domville** – Wilfrid's Eton/Oxford friend, African explorer persona; was actually an impostor (real Eric Domville lives in Cape Town); a gang agent (passed as Charles Denton in Manchester); shot Arthur Rumbold in Charlton Wood; later poisoned himself in cell (strychnine pill).
- **Ralph Vickers** – sleek-haired blackmailer/spy; ex-convict (3 yrs); arrested after returning from Germany with stolen jewels/money.
- **John Parham** ("Nello", real name Lionel; alias Humphreys) – wholesale jeweller, Keymer, Sydenham Hill; wife Mrs Parham (~26, brown hair, abused, attempted suicide with sublimate); house in Clipstone Street, "House of Doom" with fatal stairs; arrested.
- **Arthur Rumbold** – medical student at Guy's, son of Canon Rumbold of Lincoln (Folkingham); Tibbie's secret lover; killed in Charlton Wood by Domville.
- **Charlie / Charles Denton** – blackmail accomplice in Pendleton, Manchester; letter from "R.W." (dead man's signature) re: Chichester Dolphin meeting.
- **Mrs Williams** – landlady, Neate Street, Camberwell (husband foreman at mineral-water factory); **Budd** – Wilfrid's manservant; **Rainer** – under-butler; **Adams** – old butler at Ryhall; **Mason** – Tibbie's maid; **Annette/Robert** not in Book 1.
- Police: **Booth** (East Marden constable), **Dr Richards**, **Inspector Pickering** (Tottenham Court Road), sergeants **Edwards**, **Marvin**, constable **Horton**, **Inspector Nicholls**; Scotland Yard.
- **Sybil's lover-victim** "Ralph"/"Charles" aliases; pawnbroker Fulham Road ticket in name "Green"; **Mrs Parham's maid Jane** died of chloroform; cook; gardener **Lane**; **Harry Lane**; **Harker's Hotel**, Waterloo Road; **Sidney Humphreys** (alias for Parham); **Hunt**; **Chief Constable** etc.

### Setting/places
Ryhall Place (Sussex, Tudor, Long Gallery, Dame Grace's Room), East Marden, Charlton Wood, Midhurst (Spread Eagle inquest), Chichester, Bolton Street, Bond Street, Clipstone Street, Dean's Yard, Empire, Boodle's, Baker Street, Camberwell (Neate Street), Newcastle (Douglas Hotel), Carlisle, Glasgow (Central Station Hotel), Fort William, Oban, Dumfries, Leeds (Roundhay Road), Sydenham, Keymer, Caledonian Hotel (Adelphi), Euston Road hotel, Leazes Park, Temple Newsham, Amersham (final home).

### Event sequence
1. Ryhall, Long Gallery: Tibbie refuses marriage to Wilfrid; says she will marry Winsloe; then says she has a "secret" and bursts into tears.
2. Dinner; 2am Eric reports overhearing Tibbie with lover "Charles" in Charlton Wood at ~4pm; heard him say "Sybil! You will marry me..."; Eric saw revolver, heard shot. Rainer reports body found in Charlton Wood.
3. Wilfrid & Eric go to wood, search body, take papers, wallet, locket (miniature of Sybil, inscribed "From Sybil—August 14th"), pawn tickets, Parham card, cipher sheet, letters. Booth, Richards, Superintendent arrive; Eric sees a figure hiding.
4. Letters from Sybil (Hethe Hall, Regina, Hotel Ritz, Ryhall, Durham) found; Wilfrid keeps them.
5. Tibbie comes to Wilfrid at night; asks him to pose as her husband ("compositor"), confesses she needs to flee; they agree; she drives off in Mercedes with Mason at night; Mason sent to Bournemouth.
6. London: Tibbie at Elephant & Castle hotel; Camberwell lodgings Neate St, Mrs Williams; "Mr & Mrs William Morton", "Willie"/"Molly".
7. Winsloe's inquest: photo of dead man found in Winsloe's kitbag; "White Feather" cipher advertisements; pawnbroker; Sydenham visit (Parham, Mrs Parham, Jane's murder by chloroform during robbery; secret cavity; human eye).
8. Wilfrid entrapped at Empire/Humphreys' house (Regent St area), falls through stairs, swept into sewer; escapes at Oxford St/Hart St; Pickering.
9. Tibbie tells Wilfrid to advertise; they go to Leeds, Newcastle (Mrs Morton); Carlisle; Glasgow; Fort William; Mrs Rumbold (Arthur's mother) at Oban/Dumfries.
10. Wilfrid traces Parham to Clipstone Street "House of Doom"; police raid; Edwards, Marvin, Horton; stairs trap; secret well; Domville found alive in cell; Vickers and Parham arrested.
11. Tibbie's confession (Vickers, Versailles, Admiral Hellard, French naval submarine plans, Arthur Rumbold shot by Domville in Charlton Wood).
12. Ending: Wilfrid and Tibbie marry (Jack's approval); home near Amersham given by Lady Scarcliff; Winsloe in Buenos Ayres; Parham & Vickers await trial; epigraph "Whatsoever a Man Soweth, that shall he also Reap."

## BOOK 2: "The Weight of the Crown" by Fred M. White (Gutenberg 36511)

### Core cast
- **Jessie Harcourt** – shop-girl/fitter-on at Madame Malmaison's (Bond Street), daughter of late Colonel Harcourt (Royal Galways); dismissed after Prince Boris Mazaroff's attempted kiss; sister **Ada Harcourt** (delicate, paints; lodging off Oxford St). Jessie strikingly resembles Vera.
- **Vera Galloway** – niece/adopted daughter of Lord & Lady Merehaven (Gordon Gardens No. 17); lover **Charles Maxwell** (Lord Merehaven's private secretary); cousin **Captain Ronald Hope** (Jessie's old sweetheart; going to India/Asturian service); injured by cab in Piccadilly, taken to Charing Cross Hospital.
- **Queen Margaret of Asturia** – tall, tiara, consort of **King Erno** (drunken, gambling, flame-red hair, weak; "the drunken rascal"); Erno kept at Merehaven House; drugs by **Dr Salerno** remedy / Dr Varney.
- **General Paul Maxgregor** – Scottish, Asturian service; loves queen; shot in shoulder by garden spy; lodgings with porter/valet **Robert** (not same as Book 1).
- **Prince Boris Mazaroff** – Russian; Princess Mazaroff his mother; accomplice **Igon**; **Count Gleikstein** (Russian chargé d'affaires).
- **Lechmere** – ex-queen's messenger, grey, greyhound-like; ally.
- **Dr Varney** – physician with grey beard, twinkling eyes; ally; Varney's servant.
- **Countess Saens** (Connaught Crescent, formerly Vera Olpheut, morganatic; maid **Annette**, Swiss-French; **Robert** valet-lover); **Hunt** – American editor of Evening Mercury (Fleet St).
- **Lord Merehaven** (Foreign Secretary); **Lady Merehaven** (short-sighted); **Sir Reginald Lancing** (son Captain Dick Lancing committed suicide); **Pongo** = Honourable George Lascelles (motor-car); **Prince Peretori** of Nassa (practical joker, impersonator of Erno); **Miss Cheylesmere**; **Eveleigh** editor of Daily Herald; **Inspector Taske**; **Roscoe**; **Captain Alexis** (king's guard); **Tomani** (Asturian minister); **Prince Alix** (successor); **Madame Peri** (diva); **Pierre Loti** (peasant at crash); **Ada**; **Bannister** (footman).

### Event sequence
1. Madame Malmaison dismisses Jessie; mysterious letter to 17 Gordon Gardens; Jessie goes disguised; swaps with Vera.
2. Queen Margaret instructs Jessie: lock General Maxgregor in room; wait by fountain; signal flashes.
3. Mazaroff confronts Jessie at fountain; Ronald Hope recognizes Jessie via dog-rose game; Hope removes Mazaroff.
4. Upstairs: King Erno drugged; Maxgregor shot through window blind (note: "pull down the blind").
5. Jessie gets Ronald; Maxgregor escapes as the king via lane; spy (tall fair woman) baffled; Jessie sent to supper; hospital message: Vera injured.
6. Dr Varney recognizes Jessie; grants permit; Jessie uses Pongo's car to Charing Cross.
7. Countess Saens's burglary: maid Annette accuses Jessie; papers from Dutch cabinet stolen by Vera.
8. Lechmere leads to Hunt/Carlton; Hunt confirms paper printed pre-theft interview; Lancing suicide; Lord Merehaven's papers; Vera lost papers in Piccadilly accident.
9. Gleikstein, Mazaroff; king appears at Merehaven drawing-room (double = Peretori).
10. Lechmere at Mercury office; Eveleigh of Herald contradicts; Peretori impersonation exposed in Countess's wardrobe; papers found in Annette's room (plaster cast of Adoration of Magi / crucifix).
11. Peretori drugs? Mazaroff arrested Paris; king (real) dead in train crash near Amiens; Loti's hut; body hidden in straw; Varney certifies death of shock; Maxgregor tells queen; Tomani telegram.
12. Countess Saens arrested; Lechmere retrieves Deed of Abdication from king's dress suit and papers from Annette's room.
13. Ending: Maxwell cleared; Vera & Maxwell reconciled; Jessie & Ronald engaged; queen to marry Maxgregor eventually ("I am going to ... try").
